input.title: India's generative AI startup wave: 200 new companies launched in 2024
input.summary: India produced over 200 new generative AI startups in 2024, with the pace accelerating into early 2025, according to an iSPIRT report released in March 2025. Bengaluru and Hyderabad account for 60 percent of India's generative AI startups. The most common applications are coding assistance, document processing, and vernacular language AI.
